Two row actions: "this is our current product" (variant attributes -> node preview -> set -> new requirement ->
automatic second search on the extended parameter set) and "start assessment" (POST /assessments).
Every search is built from the hospital requirement alone: there is no pivot mode (D46).
The hub stores nothing from a search (only tenant, time and counts in short-retention access logs).
